description: The checks set on the Problems page beside what the judge reads: the token limit per turn (on or off, and the most tokens one turn may use; a turn over it is reported as a problem), whether a conversation whose last message got no reply is reported (unanswered messages), and the custom checks added by hand (create_custom_check). Change the first two with set_checks.
